subject: Aeroworks onboarding: W-9, COI endorsement, and PO timing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@aeroworks.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aeroworks onboarding: W-9, COI endorsement, and PO timing

Hi Liam —

Welcome — excited to get Aeroworks set up with Redwood Inference. Procurement asked me to confirm a short list of items we need to issue a purchase order and move into a production relationship: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured with a Waiver of Subrogation and a policy endorsement that shows General Liability limits of at least $1M per occurrence.
- A completed W-9 (we need the legal business name and tax ID to populate the PO).
- Subcontractor/vendor list (if you use any third parties on this engagement) so we can confirm coverage flows to subs.
- Procurement onboarding form & vendor remittance (I attached our onboarding form for your convenience).

Notes on timing: once we receive a COI with the endorsement language above and a valid W-9, Procurement can issue a conditional PO (Net30 terms) the same week; final activation is contingent on the endorsement being visible on the insurer's certificate or an insurer endorsement PDF.

If you can send the COI and W-9 as PDFs, and the subcontractor list as a spreadsheet, that will keep things moving. If your COI issuer needs specific wording, please see the exact endorsement phrase below that our legal & procurement require: 

"The certificate holder, Redwood Inference, Inc., and its subsidiaries are named as Additional Insured with a Waiver of Subrogation where permitted by law. The policy shall be primary and non-contributory as to Redwood Inference, Inc."

I've copied Dylan (procurement) and Marissa (account lead) — Dylan will confirm the PO number and next steps once the paperwork looks good.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the checklist. Please find attached our COI and W-9. The subcontractor list is being finalized today and I expect to send it over before COB.

Would a separate endorsement PDF be acceptable?

Also confirming Aeroworks is happy with Net30 and looks forward to receiving the PO. If you need any further contact details for the insurer, cc'd contracts@aeroworks.io handles proofs and endorsements.

Best regards,

Hi Liam —

Thanks for sending the COI and W-9, appreciate the quick response. A separate endorsement (e.g., CG 20 10) is acceptable as long as the endorsement language explicitly names Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured and includes Waiver of Subrogation where permitted. Please ensure the endorsement effective date covers the full term of the agreement.

Next steps from Procurement: 
- Please upload the endorsement PDF in reply to this thread or to our vendor portal: https://procurement.redwood-inference.com/vendor-portal/awk-9876
- Complete the vendor remittance section on the attached procurement_onboarding_form_20270605.pdf and return it to finance@redwood-inference.com. We need the bank account name, routing/IBAN, and remittance contact for the PO setup.
- Once finance confirms bank details and the endorsement is accepted, Procurement will issue a conditional PO (PO# will be provided in the portal). The conditional PO becomes active when legal confirms the endorsement and the W-9 matches the remittance details.

Invoice instructions: send invoices to ap@redwood-inference.com referencing the PO number. Please do not send invoices to individual emails — they must go to the AP mailbox to be processed.

I have attached the onboarding form for completion. If there are any GLA/GL limits listed differently on the insurer paperwork, flag them here and we can discuss exceptions, but standard practice is $1M/$2M.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: procurement_onboarding_form_20270605.pdf
